site.name: Schönes Deutschland
site.description: An immersive guide to Germany's castles, alps, forests, coasts and historic cities — 16 destinations, told properly.

hero.headline: Discover the soul of Germany
hero.subline: Fairytale castles above Alpine gorges, forests that swallow the light, chalk cliffs over a cold sea, and cities rebuilt stone by numbered stone.

featured.title: Featured destinations
featured.description: Nine places that show the range of the country, from a glacial lake in the Alps to old-growth beech forest on the Baltic.

themes.title: Explore by theme
themes.description: Six ways through the country. Pick the one that matches the trip you actually want.

seasons.title: Best time to visit
seasons.description: Germany changes character four times a year. Here is what each one offers — and where it shows best.

closing.title: Ready to go?
closing.description: Build a route from the places that caught your eye. Everything is saved in your browser — no account, no email.

destinations.title: All destinations
destinations.description: Sixteen places across Germany. Filter by region, theme or the season that suits them best.
destinations.emptyBody: Try widening the season or clearing a filter — there are sixteen places in here somewhere.

trip.title: Plan your trip
trip.description: Save places as you browse and they collect here as a route. Stored in your browser only.
trip.emptyBody: Browse the destinations and tap “Save to my trip” on anything that looks good. It will show up here as a route on the map.

regions.title: Regions of Germany
regions.description: Nine regions, sixteen destinations. Use the map to explore, or the list below if you would rather read.
regions.mapLabel: Interactive map of German destinations. Use the list below for a keyboard-accessible alternative.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.description: Every photograph in this guide, in one place. Each one links back to its source and licence.

about.title: About & credits
about.intro: Schönes Deutschland is a demonstration of what a travel guide can feel like when the photography is given room and the writing is given time. It is a static site: no tracking, no accounts, no backend.
about.photosBody: Every photograph comes from Wikimedia Commons and is used under the licence stated on its source page. Files are downloaded and optimised locally rather than hotlinked. Photographer, licence and source link are listed below for each image.
about.dataBody: Coordinates, region boundaries and factual details were compiled from Wikipedia, Wikimedia Commons, the UNESCO World Heritage list and Germany's national tourist board. Map tiles are served by OpenStreetMap contributors.
about.techBody: Next.js with the App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion and Leaflet. Content lives in typed local data files; there is no CMS and no database.

notFound.title: Off the map
notFound.description: This page does not exist — but sixteen real places do. Try one of those instead.

footer.tagline: A visual guide to the beauty of Germany.
footer.builtWith: Built with Next.js. Photography from Wikimedia Commons.
